patterns.note: Full-width sections alternate between clean white/light gray backgrounds for text-heavy content and full-bleed, high-impact image backgrounds with overlaid text for key business areas.
Headings use a bold, sans-serif font with significant size variation, from an oversized hero title to moderately large section titles, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
A restrained palette of white, dark gray, and light gray is punctuated by a vibrant, consistent red used exclusively for calls-to-action, interactive elements, and brand accents.

The header initially appears transparent over the hero, then shrinks in height and gains a solid white background as the user scrolls down, remaining sticky at the top of the viewport. The hero's background image collage has a subtle fixed or parallax effect, revealing more of the image as foreground content scrolls over it.

Key business and corporate sections are introduced with large, full-bleed photographic backgrounds, often with a subtle dark overlay, featuring a prominent white heading and a 'Learn More' call-to-action.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is built to be initially transparent and full-height, then transitions to a compact, solid white background with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls past the hero section, using a fixed position.

The hero section features a dynamic, multi-image collage that acts as a background, possibly using a canvas element or a fixed background attachment, over which the main text content scrolls. This collage also functions as a carousel, likely powered by Swiper, with visible navigation arrows and pagination dots.

Content sections are revealed by simply scrolling into view, without complex fade-in or slide-up animations for the sections themselves, relying on the sticky header and hero parallax for primary motion interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero heading (~3-4x body) with large, bold section headings (~2x body) and standard body text, all from the same sans-serif family.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, image containers have slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major content sections, creating a clear visual rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its dynamic hero section, which uses a rich, multi-image collage as a background that subtly parallaxes or remains fixed as foreground content scrolls. This immediately conveys the breadth of the brand's offerings in a visually engaging way, moving beyond a single hero image or video.
